# Duct

> Duct is an open-source (MIT) AI agent that reads across product, marketing and revenue tools together and answers questions a single dashboard cannot. Run it on your own machine with your own model API keys, self-host it, or use the hosted version at getduct.ai.

Duct is built and maintained by Shirish Kadam in Valencia, Spain. The full source — FastAPI backend, agents, Next.js app and Tauri desktop shell — is at https://github.com/5hirish/duct under the MIT licence.

It connects 12 sources: Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Search Console, Tag Manager, Meta Ads, Apple Search Ads, OpenAI Ads, Mixpanel, Microsoft Clarity, GrowthBook, Stripe and RevenueCat. Duct reads by default; when it can fix something it prepares a change set, shows a preview and a guardrail check, and waits for a human to approve. There is no agent-facing approve or apply tool — that boundary is enforced in code, not in a prompt.

Intended for product managers, growth leads and marketing teams who need cross-tool insight without a data team, and for engineers who would rather run the thing themselves than trust a black box.

## Free Tools

- [SaaS Metrics Benchmark Calculator](https://getduct.ai/tools/saas-metrics-calculator): Free interactive calculator that benchmarks your SaaS metrics — monthly churn, LTV:CAC ratio, CAC payback period, and trial-to-paid conversion rate — against industry medians from OpenView 2024 and ChartMogul 2023. Enter MRR, churn rate, CAC, and LTV (or auto-calculate from ARPU and churn). Results are colour-coded green/amber/red. For B2B SaaS founders, growth leads, and CFOs.
- [Weekly Marketing Brief Template Generator](https://getduct.ai/tools/weekly-brief-template): Free multi-step generator that builds a customised weekly marketing report template based on your role (Growth PM, Performance Marketer, or SEO Lead) and tool stack (GA4, Mixpanel, HubSpot, Google Ads, Ahrefs, Search Console, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads). Outputs the right metric slots and section headers per tool. Copy with one click.
- [CAC / LTV Calculator](https://getduct.ai/tools/cac-ltv-calculator): Free SaaS unit economics calculator. Enter monthly new customers, total sales and marketing spend, ARPU, and customer lifespan. Instantly calculates CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC ratio, and CAC payback period with health scores and one-line interpretations. Benchmarks from OpenView, SaaStr, and Bessemer Venture Partners.
- [MRR Growth Rate Calculator](https://getduct.ai/tools/mrr-growth-calculator): Free SaaS growth calculator for tracking net MRR growth and compound monthly growth rate (CMGR) across any period. Enter starting MRR, ending MRR, and months to get growth diagnostics, plus optional required CMGR to reach a target MRR.
- [Engagement Rate Calculator](https://getduct.ai/tools/engagement-rate-calculator): Free engagement rate calculator for content and growth teams. Compute engagement rate by followers, reach, and impressions, plus average engagements per post, with practical interpretation bands for weak/healthy/high-performing content.
- [CTR Calculator](https://getduct.ai/tools/ctr-calculator): Free click-through rate calculator for paid and organic channels. Enter impressions and clicks to calculate CTR, then model projected clicks at target CTR and required CTR to hit click goals.
- [CPM Calculator](https://getduct.ai/tools/cpm-calculator): Free cost-per-mille calculator for campaign planning. Enter spend and impressions to calculate CPM, projected spend at target CPM, and required CPM to stay inside budget.
- [CPC Calculator](https://getduct.ai/tools/cpc-calculator): Free cost-per-click calculator for campaign planning. Enter spend and clicks to calculate CPC, projected spend at target CPC, and required CPC to stay inside budget.
- [CPA Calculator](https://getduct.ai/tools/cpa-calculator): Free cost-per-acquisition calculator for marketers. Enter spend and conversions to calculate CPA, projected conversions at target CPA, and required CPA to stay within budget.
- [Marketing ROI Calculator](https://getduct.ai/tools/marketing-roi-calculator): Free marketing ROI calculator. Enter spend and attributed revenue to calculate ROI, net profit, and target-revenue scenarios for campaign planning.
- [ROAS Calculator](https://getduct.ai/tools/roas-calculator): Free ROAS (return on ad spend) calculator for paid media. Enter ad spend and attributed revenue to get ROAS as a multiple, optional target ROAS scenarios (revenue gap and max efficient spend), and optional gross-margin contribution ROAS.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://getduct.ai/): Overview of Duct — what it does, who it's for, and how to join the early access waitlist.
- [For Product Intelligence](https://getduct.ai/for-product-intelligence): How Duct connects Mixpanel, Intercom, Linear, and Salesforce into a daily PM brief with cross-tool correlations and anomaly alerts.
- [For Organic Growth](https://getduct.ai/for-organic-growth): How Duct surfaces SEO and content performance signals from Search Console, Ahrefs, and GA4 into a weekly action brief.
- [For Paid Ads](https://getduct.ai/for-paid-ads): How Duct unifies Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and X signals into one paid performance brief with cross-channel recommendations.
- [Free SEO Audit](https://getduct.ai/seo-audit): Runs an AI-powered technical and content SEO audit against a sitemap and returns a scored, prioritised report.
- [Doctrine](https://getduct.ai/doctrine): The seven opinions Duct is built on, each linked to the file that enforces it — approval-gated execution, renting rather than marrying an agent harness, membership-based authorization, and why agent-written contributions are welcome.
- [About](https://getduct.ai/about): Duct is built and maintained by Shirish Kadam in Valencia, Spain. MIT licensed.
- [Blog](https://getduct.ai/blog/): Articles on product intelligence, SEO strategy, and growth analytics for SaaS teams.

## Open source

- [Duct on GitHub](https://github.com/5hirish/duct): The whole project is MIT licensed — FastAPI backend, five agents, Next.js app and a Tauri v2 desktop shell that bundles the backend as a local sidecar (SQLite on disk, loopback only, provider keys in the OS keychain). No account is needed to run it locally.
- [The Duct Doctrine](https://getduct.ai/doctrine): The seven positions the project is built on, each linked to the file that enforces it.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/5hirish/duct/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup, the checks CI runs, and the conventions. Agent-written contributions are explicitly welcome; the PR template asks where an agent helped so a reviewer knows where to look hardest.
- [Discussions](https://github.com/5hirish/duct/discussions): Questions, ideas and design debate.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/5hirish/duct/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
